name: Upon a Darkening Flood
source:
They say that after the Revolution, some great aristocrats went awry, and took part in depraved, occult rituals.

They don't understand why Lord D was among them. Wasn't he an ardent defender of the Revolution?

There's talk of terrible events occurring in his personal library.

They say he didn't like it, never went anywhere near it.

They say he couldn't master it.

[From [url=https://rastagong.itch.io/upon-a-darkening-flood]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
他们说，大革命后，一些大贵族走上了邪路，参加了堕落的、神秘的仪式。

他们不明白为什么D勋爵会在他们中间。他不是革命的热心捍卫者吗？

有传言说他的私人图书馆里发生了可怕的事件。

他们说他不喜欢它，从来没有靠近过它。

他们说他无法掌握它。

[来自[url=https://rastagong.itch.io/upon-a-darkening-flood]itch.io[/url]]
